description: Dominance residual stream architecture. Stream is canonical ±1 dominance of dim P=2016 (E=64 → P = 64*63/2). Token embedder → V2D(E, STE) → initial stream. Each block: D2V(stream)→Euclidean(E), Q/K/V/out_proj as in exp039 → block emits non-canonical dominance [B,T,P] (drop out_canon/out_to_vec). Stream update: stream = DominanceCanonicalize(E)(stream + block_out). Unembedder: Linear(P→V), no LN, no concat. Each layer has its own D2V(stream→x) with separate LN params. n_steps=8000 quick check vs exp020 (1.8286 baseline).
